title: Work progress (progress.json)
description: Runtime state for work. Single completion list per mode. Written by session-handoff.md's 'Set session fields' block, which renames a pid-suffixed temp over the file.

completed.description: Chunk IDs completed. In plan mode: phase IDs from spec.phases[]. In fix-findings mode: theme IDs (`theme-<slug>`) as work's fix-findings-mode reference defines them.

commands_run.description: Forensic log of commands run during the chunk. Each entry may be a free-form summary string OR an object carrying at least command and exit_code. Nothing downstream reads this programmatically, so the object form is open on purpose: ADR-001 Principle 4 files this field as ceremony, and a closed object made that a lie. A run on 2026-08-21 wrote `stdout` where the example writes `stdout_tail` and failed validation over a field nothing reads.

checkpoint_commits.description: One entry per chunk committed at its checkpoint, written immediately after that chunk's commit. Names the same chunks as completed[] — a failed commit removes the chunk from completed[] and writes no entry here, leaving it in neither list. A chunk in completed[] with no entry here means the process died between those two writes; resume looks the commit up by its Ixion-Chunk trailer and either re-appends the entry or, if the commit never landed, drops the chunk from completed[] so its wave re-runs it.
